name: Marsh (Oracle Mystery)
body:
Class Skills: An oracle with the marsh mystery adds Knowledge (nature), Perception, Survival, and Swim to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells

mudball (2nd), mud buddy (4th), soothing mud (6th), explosion of rot (8th), ride the waves (10th), fluid form (12th), swarm skin (14th), insect spies, greater (16th), summon froghemoth (18th).

Revelations: An oracle with the marsh mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Amphibious Nature (Ex)

You can breathe water as easily as air. You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Fluid Nature (Ex)

You receive a +4 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Defense against bull rush, drag, grapple, reposition, and trip attempts. A creature trying to confirm a critical hit against you has a -4 penalty on its confirmation roll. At 5th level, you gain Dodge as a bonus feat. You do not need to meet the prerequisite to gain this feat.

Hydra From Below (Sp)

As a standard action, you can cause a hydra head to appear in as many as 5 empty squares within 60 feet of yourself. Each head immediately makes 1 bite attack against a target you designate that is within 10 feet of it. The head uses your Bab + your Charisma modifier on attack rolls. Each head deals 1d8 + your Charisma modifier damage. After its attack (whether successful or not), the head disappears. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day for every four levels you possess beyond 7th level. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Mud Mire (Sp)

As a standard action, you can fire a globule of mud at a target within 30 feet. If you succeed on a ranged touch attack against the target, it is encased in mud and is slowed (as the slow spell) for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier. At 11th level, the range for this ability increases to 60 feet and at the end of the duration, the target must make a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier). On a successful save, the mud crumbles away causing no further inconvenience. On a failed save, the mud hardens into an immovable shell and the target gains the paralyzed condition. Each round at the start of its turn, the target can attempt a DC 20 Strength check to burst free of the mud, ending the paralysis. Dispel magic also removes the mud as does being magically drenched with water. A creature can also either manually drench the target or manipulate the target’s limbs as a full-round action to crack and dislodge the mud, freeing the target. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day for every four levels you possess beyond 7th level. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Natural Healer (Ex)

As long as you are outdoors or underground in a natural setting, you reduce the number of consecutive successful saves needed to recover from a disease or poison by 1 (to a minimum of 1). Additionally, you can sacrifice one of your unused spell slots for the day (as a free action) to gain an enhancement bonus equal to 1 + that spell slot’s level on a saving throw you make to resist the effects of poison or disease.

Path of the Cottonmouth (Su)

Once per day, as a standard action, you can become incorporeal. You can then move up to 3 times your base land speed in any direction, including through objects (except for those made of force). Movement while in this form never provokes attacks of opportunity. You remain in incorporeal form until the start of your next turn. At 15th level, you can use this ability twice per day. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Spirit of the Marsh (Su)

As a swift action, you can summon the spirit of a froghemoth, and allow it to bolster your physical prowess. You gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength and a +4 natural armor bonus to AC. Your base attack bonus, while possessed, equals your oracle level. You grow eyestalks which grant you all-around vision (you can’t be flanked) and your two arms turn into tentacles and two other tentacles sprout from your torso. (If you are holding anything in your hands when you activate this ability, the items fall to the ground at your feet.) Your four tentacles are considered primary natural weapons that deal 1d8 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage. You can use this ability for 1 round for every 2 oracle levels you possess. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-round increments. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Marsh Stride (Ex)

You never treat marsh, swamp, bog, fen, or mangrove terrain as difficult terrain for the purpose of slogging through mud. At 3rd level, you gain a swim speed of 30 feet.

Mosquito Skin (Ex)

As a swift action, you can transform your skin into a writhing mass of mosquitoes that grant you a +1 deflection bonus and a 10% miss chance (similar to a blur spell, but with less powerful concealment). At 7th level, this deflection bonus increases to +2 and the concealment benefit increases to 20 percent. You can use your mosquito skin for 10 minutes per day per oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 10-minute increments.

Water Magic (Sp)

When you gain this revelation, select one spell from any class list that has the water descriptor and is a level you can cast. You add this spell to your list of spells known. Additionally, you can cast this spell once per day as a spell-like ability. Whenever you gain a new revelation, you can choose to discard this spell and swap it for a different spell with the water descriptor.

Final Revelation

Upon reaching 20th level, your body becomes as malleable as the water in the wetlands you treasure. You are constantly under the effects of freedom of movement, you gain immunity to the grappled and entangled conditions, and your Dexterity score increases by +2.
